brief:
**BLUF:** No major law enforcement incidents, fires, or hazards reported in Tazewell County or immediate core area (Tazewell, Richlands, Bluefield VA/WV, Mercer County) in the last 24 hours. Bluefield WV Police released a bench warrant list on Nov. 13. Regionally, a Mercer County man faces child solicitation charges (Nov. 10) and a convicted double-murderer was sentenced on federal gun charges (Nov. 13). Key upcoming items include a Nov. 24 hearing in Tazewell Circuit Court on a challenge to a constitutional amendment and a Bristol District traffic alert for Nov. 16-22.[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/crime/mercer-county-crime/bluefield-west-virginia-police-department-releases-bench-warrant-list-55/)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
**Core:** Bluefield West Virginia Police Department released a bench warrant list on Nov. 13, 2026, for individuals with outstanding municipal court warrants (offenses may include obstructing an officer, DUI, destruction of property, assault, drug paraphernalia, possession of a controlled substance, prostitution, and others). The list is not exhaustive; contact 304-327-6101 (option 1) to confirm. Names and details available via department channels.[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/crime/mercer-county-crime/bluefield-west-virginia-police-department-releases-bench-warrant-list-55/)

A Mercer County man, Trent Addison Nunn, 21, was charged with one count of distributing or displaying obscene material to a minor and one count of soliciting a minor via computer (incidents in Raleigh County in May; investigated by WV State Police). Arrested Nov. 6; preliminary hearing set for Nov. 16 in Raleigh County Magistrate Court. Held at Southern Regional Jail on $150,000 bond.[[2]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/11/10/mercer-county-man-charged-child-solicitation-case/)

**Region:** A convicted double-murderer was sentenced for a federal gun crime (details via WVNS reporting, Nov. 13).[[3]](https://woay.com/bluefield-police-asks-for-publics-help-in-locating-woman-wanted-on-attempted-murder-and-assault-charges/)

Nothing else reported in the last 24 hours for Tazewell County Sheriff’s Office, Virginia State Police Division IV, Richlands/Tazewell/Bluefield VA/Cedar Bluff police, or Mercer County Sheriff.

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
No active NWS alerts. No flooding, winter weather, wildfires, power outages, or boil-water notices reported in the core.

**Region/Core roads:** Bristol District weekly traffic alert covers Nov. 16-22, 2026 (VDOT).[[4]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/09/14/five-arrested-tazewell-county-drug-bust/)

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
**Core:** Tazewell County Circuit Court Judge Jack Hurley is retiring but will first rule on a challenge to a recently approved constitutional amendment (Ballot Question 1, related to reproductive freedom/abortion). Hearing rescheduled to Nov. 24 due to scheduling conflict (originally Nov. 13). Founding Freedoms Law Center seeks preliminary injunction against certification.[[5]](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/lawsuit-challenges-virginia-abortion-amendment-in-tazewell/id6785089136?i=1000801269477)

Mercer Board of Education notes “hard decisions” ahead (Bluefield Daily Telegraph, Nov. 14).[[6]](https://www.bdtonline.com/news/local_news/tazewell-supervisors-adopt-new-policy-for-non-profit-organizations/article_637368ab-3c1d-4c1a-a238-94f86f03b539.html)

Recent election results (Nov. 3, 2026) for Tazewell County towns reported in detail, including mayors and council seats in Tazewell, Richlands, and Pocahontas.[[7]](https://enr.elections.virginia.gov/results/public/tazewell-county/2026-November-General)

**Region:** Nothing additional reported in the last 24 hours for state actions directly impacting the area.

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
**Core:** Bluefield Train Show returns at Mercer Mall (Nov. 13, 10 a.m.–6 p.m.; Nov. 14, 1–5 p.m.).[[8]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/11/13/bluefield-train-show-returns-mercer-mall/)

Richlands High School band hosting pet food drive for Tazewell County Animal Shelter (announced Nov. 13).[[9]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/tazewell-county-sheriffs-office-warns-public-about-scam/)

**Region:** Virginia Haulers bringing arena football to Wytheville (announced Nov. 13).[[10]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/27/tazewell-county-sheriff-shares-halloween-safety-tips/)

## WATCH -- NEXT 48 HOURS
- Nov. 14-15: Bluefield Train Show at Mercer Mall.
- Nov. 15: Bingo with Tazewell Today at Nuckolls Hall (3 p.m.).
- Nov. 16: Preliminary hearing for Trent Addison Nunn in Raleigh County Magistrate Court.
- Nov. 16-22: Bristol District traffic impacts (VDOT).
- Nov. 24: Tazewell Circuit Court hearing on constitutional amendment challenge before Judge Hurley.[[5]](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/lawsuit-challenges-virginia-abortion-amendment-in-tazewell/id6785089136?i=1000801269477)

Nothing else developing or scheduled of note in core or region from available sources.
